create_image_encoder_vit: create an ImageEncoderViT module to encode input images into feature embeddings using a Vision Transformer backbone
build_transformer_block: build a Block module with multi-head attention and MLP for Vision Transformer feature extraction
create_attention_layer: create an Attention module with multi-head self-attention and optional relative positional embeddings
build_patch_embedding: build a PatchEmbed module to split input images into patches and project them into embedding space
partition_image_windows: partition image feature tensors into non-overlapping windows for efficient windowed attention computation
